name: doo-v13-autumn
description: smoketest_maps blizzard/(2)AutumnLeaves_S2_v2.0.w3x (war3map.doo version 8 / subversion 11 with skin ids, 6277 doodads, 55 specials) opened and saved after an empty edit: the editor's save writes the doodads file as version 13, subversion 11, the order and the specials kept, every doodad with preFlags 0xFFFFFFFF, editorId 0xFFFFFFFF and its creation number in trailer[0] (trailer [n, 0, 0]), no extras but on the 29 doodads whose model has a light (LOlp, YOlp, LOtz, ITag, GPsh, ZZys, LOth: one block, e.g. LOlp variation 1 white, intensity 12, Quadratic 0.0005, Damping 0.00001; doo-lights.json), its skin id kept; Studio's terrain-view save the same (lib/terrain/dooversion.ts, branch feat/doo-v13-upgrade; the lights since branch fix/doo-light-extras): MATCH 2026-11-23. Ignored: the height of the seaweed ZWsw 2213, which Studio's save floats to 419.15 where the editor's keeps 379.93 (fable.md, as doodad-open-z-real)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
